enrichment.summary_zh: 本批仅使用 IEEE 正式网页，未下载 PDF。20 篇中 16 篇确认 Early Access，补齐 16 篇摘要和具体在线发表日期（2026-10-19 或 2026-10-20）。作者字段全部保留；其中 5 篇页首作者截断，仅核对了显示部分，完整登记名单保留，余下作者待展开官方名单复核。4 篇被 Chrome ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT 拦截，摘要、具体发表日期和 Early Access 状态保持未确认。此前 EMNLP 补齐 24 篇作者，仍有 956 篇缺作者。
enrichment.summary_en: IEEE official pages only; no PDFs downloaded. Of 20 papers, 16 were confirmed as Early Access, with 16 abstracts and exact online publication dates added (2026-10-19 or 2026-10-20). All existing authors were retained; 5 official header bylines were truncated, so only visible authors were checked and full registered lists preserved. Chrome blocked 4 pages with ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT; their abstracts, exact dates and Early Access status remain unconfirmed. The earlier EMNLP batch filled 24 author lists; 956 remain missing.
